- Prefers backend-heavy IC roles; immediate availability in ~2 weeks

- Aug 4 (Mon): 09:00–12:00 IST / Jul 31 23:30–02:30 PDT
- Aug 5 (Tue): 13:00–17:00 IST / Aug 1 03:30–07:30 PDT

Best,
